question: How many Honda models are in each segment?
reference_sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS model_count FROM models GROUP BY segment ORDER BY model_count DESC, segment ASC

question: List the 10 Honda models with the earliest production start years.
reference_sql: SELECT name, production_start FROM models ORDER BY production_start ASC, name ASC LIMIT 10

question: How many generations does each Honda model have, including models with no recorded generations?
reference_sql: SELECT m.name, COUNT(g.gen_id) AS generation_count FROM models AS m LEFT JOIN generations AS g ON g.model_id = m.model_id GROUP BY m.model_id, m.name ORDER BY generation_count DESC, m.name ASC

question: List the five engines with the highest horsepower and include their displacement and fuel type.
reference_sql: SELECT engine_code, horsepower_hp, displacement_cc, fuel_type FROM engines ORDER BY horsepower_hp DESC, engine_code ASC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average base trim price for each Honda model?
reference_sql: SELECT m.name, ROUND(AVG(t.base_price_usd), 2) AS average_base_price_usd FROM models AS m JOIN generations AS g ON g.model_id = m.model_id JOIN trims AS t ON t.gen_id = g.gen_id WHERE t.base_price_usd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.model_id, m.name ORDER BY average_base_price_usd DESC, m.name ASC

question: Which Honda model generations received a five-star overall safety rating?
reference_sql: SELECT m.name, g.gen_label, s.rating_body, s.overall_stars, s.rating_year FROM safety AS s JOIN generations AS g ON g.gen_id = s.gen_id JOIN models AS m ON m.model_id = g.model_id WHERE s.overall_stars = 5 ORDER BY s.rating_year DESC, m.name ASC

question: How many awards has each award-winning Honda model received?
reference_sql: SELECT m.name, COUNT(a.award_id) AS award_count FROM models AS m JOIN awards AS a ON a.model_id = m.model_id GROUP BY m.model_id, m.name ORDER BY award_count DESC, m.name ASC

question: Which Honda model generations have a recorded electric range greater than zero?
reference_sql: SELECT m.name, g.gen_label, tech.ev_range_km, tech.hybrid_system FROM technology AS tech JOIN generations AS g ON g.gen_id = tech.gen_id JOIN models AS m ON m.model_id = g.model_id WHERE tech.ev_range_km > 0 ORDER BY tech.ev_range_km DESC, m.name ASC
